newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AUXIMINES RE-OPENS LA LIEVE BID.
newsitem.headline: AUXIMINES RE-OPENS LA LIEVE BID.

text.p: Belgian holding company Auximines said on Friday it was re-opening its public offer for shares in Belgium's La Lieve between January 13 to 31, 1997.
Auximines already has 92.7 percent of La Lieve shares and will request the delisting of the stock at the end of the offer, it said in a statement.
Both are part of the Brederode group , which said earlier this year it would aim to simplify its structure following the public bid on La Lieve by Auximines.
The re-opened offer was on the same terms as the original which closed on July 26.
Auximines is offering La Lieve shareholders one Brederode share per La Lieve share plus a cash payment of 1,250 Belgian francs.
La Lieve was quoted at 4,180 francs on Friday.
With Brederode at 3,200 francs, the offer values La Lieve shares at 4,450, a 6.5 percent premium over the current market price.
